analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to buy score 6 in the previous decision and maintained a wait-and-see stance for 3 consecutive sessions. Today, RSI at 39.0 confirms an attempt to exit oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to improve. The 5-day low of 270.52 is higher than the 20-day low of 269.88, indicating a potential Higher Low pattern. Trading volume surge to 2.08x increases confidence in the move. Approaching the swing support at 270.63.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($270.98) vs SMA5/20/50 ($278.65/$277.11/$282.45): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($289.36/$277.99): Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (55.2%) + Current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.4→39.0): Attempting to exit oversold, weakening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1.4368→0.3842): Continued improvement, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near bottom $269.36): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 5.59% narrowing.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($271.60): Resistance at pivot S1 level.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Considering entry on buy due to RSI exiting oversold and volume surge.
